title: Daily briefing: Vaping has ‘alarming’ risks for children
title_zh: 每日简报：青少年吸电子烟存在‘令人震惊’的风险
abstract: Vaping in childhood comes with bigger health risks than we thought. Plus, chemists can’t seem to ditch hazardous solvents and whether apocalyptic claims about AI are a dangerous distraction.
abstract_zh: 儿童期吸电子烟带来的健康风险比我们想象的更大。此外，化学家似乎无法摆脱有害溶剂，而关于人工智能的末日论断是否构成危险的分心也值得关注。
snippet: Vaping in childhood comes with bigger health risks than we thought. Plus, chemists can’t seem to ditch hazardous solvents and whether apocalyptic claims about AI are a dangerous distraction.
